bridge_listening: DevBridge: listening on {host}:{port}. Attach VS Code now (Run and Debug -> PyQGIS: Attach to running QGIS).
bridge_already_running: DevBridge: bridge is already running on port {port}.
debugpy_missing: DevBridge: the 'debugpy' package is not installed in QGIS's Python. Open DevBridge > Control Panel > 'Prepare a plugin' and press 'Prepare for debugging' (it installs debugpy), or run: python -m pip install debugpy
pycharm_not_found: No PyCharm installation found automatically. Start a 'Python Debug Server' run configuration in PyCharm, or see Manual PyCharm Instructions.
pycharm_pydevd_missing: pydevd-pycharm failed to install or import. See Manual PyCharm Instructions.
pycharm_connection_refused: Could not connect to PyCharm on {host}:{port}. In PyCharm, start the 'Python Debug Server' run configuration first, then try again.
pycharm_pypi_unreachable: Could not reach PyPI to resolve the matching pydevd-pycharm version ({error}). Check your network connection, or see Manual PyCharm Instructions to install a version by hand.
pycharm_script_saved: A reusable attach script was saved to {path}.
cp_vscode_info: Starts a debugpy server inside this QGIS session. Then in VS Code choose Run and Debug -> 'PyQGIS: Attach to running QGIS'. Host and port can be changed while the bridge is stopped.
cp_pycharm_info: PyCharm is the listener: first start a 'Python Debug Server' run configuration in PyCharm, then press Auto-configure. DevBridge finds your PyCharm build, installs the matching pydevd-pycharm and connects.
cp_project_info: Choose one of your plugins (from this QGIS profile) or any folder, then prepare it: creates a .venv that can import qgis, installs debugpy and writes the VS Code configuration.
cp_browse_title: Choose a plugin or project folder
cp_project_missing: Choose an existing plugin or project folder first.
cp_vscode_missing: VS Code's 'code' command was not found on PATH. Open the folder in VS Code manually (or enable 'Add to PATH' in its installer).
cp_tool_info: The same operations are available as a separate desktop program that does not need QGIS to be running (handy for setting up before you start QGIS). It shares its settings with this plugin.
cp_tool_missing: The bundled desktop tool was not found. Reinstall DevBridge from plugins.qgis.ge.
cp_no_tk: No Python with Tk (tkinter) was found to run the desktop tool. Install Python from python.org (keep 'tcl/tk and IDLE' ticked), or run the tool from the folder with your own Python: python -m devbridge gui
